about.label: Frontend Engineer · 5+ years
about.title: I build reliable frontend systems for complex products.
about.description: I turn data-heavy requirements into resilient product workflows with React, TypeScript, Angular, Next.js, and Cypress—from UI architecture and API integration to validation, accessibility, and production-ready test automation.

experience.description: Building reliable, data-heavy workflows for Monetization Product Catalog, with a focus on UI architecture, error handling, and test automation.
details: Designed a reusable Oracle VBCS and Redwood error-handling framework across eight Offers and Attribute-Based Rules surfaces, covering API, validation, localized, and recovery states.
Built Cypress end-to-end automation for Charge Offer and Bundle Offer editing, with shared commands, fixtures, locators, and validation scenarios.
Delivered lifecycle, initiative, import/export, and concurrency workflows across Offers, Bundles, Balances, Rules, Service Design, General Ledger, and Taxation.

experience.description: Built React, Next.js, and Angular applications for healthcare data validation, network data automation, and configurable enterprise workflows.
details: Built a React and Next.js workflow for sensitive-data classification and LOINC validation, including upload, review, validation, and export flows that reduced end-user processing time by 65%.
Developed Angular pricing and lookup-maintenance modules using configurable forms, role-based access, and spreadsheet export for network data automation.
Created Figma prototypes and supported production releases through quality fixes, deployment support, and stakeholder-facing proof of concepts.
